webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: Each event is pushed to your endpoint as an OpenTelemetry log record, signed with HMAC-SHA256 so the receiver can prove it came from here.
webhooks.typesHint: Choose which events to send. With nothing selected the client receives all of them.
webhooks.rotated: Secret replaced. Update the receiver before the next event.
webhooks.examplesHint: Verify the signature before trusting the body. An endpoint that accepts any POST it receives is an endpoint anyone can feed.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.hint: Lets an external agent ask what the camera has seen. Read only: nothing it can call changes the catalogue, the users or the running detection.
mcp.scopesHint: A token can do only what its scopes allow. Grant the narrowest set that works.
mcp.addressHint: Where the agent should reach this instance. The default is the address your browser is using, which is wrong when the agent runs elsewhere.
mcp.examplesHint: Configuration for the common clients. The token goes in the Authorization header.
mcp.toolEvents: recorded events, filtered by type, subject or time.
mcp.toolScene: what is in front of the camera right now.
mcp.toolSubjects: the people and objects this instance can recognise.
mcp.toolOtlp: the same events in OTLP form, for a collector.
mcp.toolStatus: which models are loaded and whether the hardware is accelerated.
mcp.readOnly: There is no tool that writes. An agent can read what was observed and nothing else.
